mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_mission_progress (member_id, mission_id, period_start_date, progress_value) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{missionId}, #{periodStartDate}, #{progressValue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE progress_value = progress_value + VALUES(progress_value)

INSERT INTO exp_grant_log (member_id, mission_id, mission_cycle, period_start_date, granted_exp) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{missionId}, #{missionCycle}, #{periodStartDate}, #{grantedExp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mission_id = mission_id
